activity.notes: John A. Macdonald returned to office as Prime Minister of Canada on 17 October 1878 after the intervening Alexander Mackenzie ministry and remained Prime Minister until his death on 6 June 1891. Because the 1873-1878 interval was a genuine period out of office, this is modeled as a second distinct Activity.

sources.title: National Program for the Grave Sites of Canadian Prime Ministers
sources.citation_text: Parks Canada lists the Right Honourable Sir John Alexander Macdonald as Prime Minister from 1 July 1867 to 5 November 1873 and again from 17 October 1878 to 6 June 1891.

sources.title: Third Ministry - Guide to Canadian Ministries since Confederation
sources.citation_text: The Government of Canada's Guide to Canadian Ministries identifies the Third Ministry as 17 October 1878 to 6 June 1891 and names the Right Honourable Sir John Alexander Macdonald as Prime Minister.

sources.title: MACDONALD, Sir JOHN ALEXANDER
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of Canadian Biography provides scholarly biographical context for Macdonald's political career and leadership through Confederation and the later Dominion period.
